name: Starship delivery robot
def: Six wheeled sidewalk robot that carries groceries and meals a few kilometres from a hub to a customer, navigating autonomously with remote human oversight.
body: The Starship robot is a knee high six wheeled electric container that crosses sidewalks and road crossings at walking pace. It drives itself using cameras, ultrasonic sensors, radar and satellite positioning, while remote operators monitor fleets and take over at difficult crossings. Cargo sits in a locked bin that the customer opens from a phone app. Fleets work university campuses, suburbs and town centres in the United States, the United Kingdom, Finland, Denmark and Estonia.

Starship's coolers on wheels have crossed streets in dozens of cities and campuses since 2016, passing millions of commercial deliveries years before any rival. The company was founded by two Skype co founders in Estonia.
facts: Passed 9 million autonomous deliveries in October 2025, with a fleet of roughly 2,700 robots
Founded in 2014 in Tallinn, Estonia, by Skype co founders Ahti Heinla and Janus Friis
Delivers for Grubhub on university campuses, and for Co op and Tesco stores in the United Kingdom
specs: Six wheels driven by electric hub motors
Cameras, ultrasonic sensors, radar, satellite positioning and inertial measurement
Autonomous navigation with remote operators supervising and able to take control
